# Vendored libraries

`preact-htm.js`: [Preact](https://preactjs.com) 10 with hooks, plus [htm](https://github.com/developit/htm) 3.1.1 (tagged-template JSX), in one ES module.
Source: `https://unpkg.com/htm@3.1.1/preact/standalone.module.js`. Licences: Preact is MIT (`LICENSE-preact.txt`), htm is Apache-2.0 (`LICENSE-htm.txt`). SHA-256: `72284e8e9079c87817145df1110f74e8a2aa040b2fc384922e18dfcb46fc1fd7`.
It is copied here so the client needs no build step and no network.
